# Combobox

A single-select field that filters its options as the user types.

- **Import:** `import { Combobox } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-combobox--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Combobox, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const options = [
  {
    value: "overview",
    label: "Overview",
    description: "Summary and key signals",
  },
  {
    value: "details",
    label: "Details",
    description: "Full record information",
  },
  {
    value: "activity",
    label: "Activity",
    description: "Recent changes and updates",
  },
];

export function ComboboxExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-80">
        <Combobox label="View" options={options} />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Combobox

It forwards its ref to `HTMLInputElement`. Its props are `ComboboxProps`, which extends `Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "children" | "defaultValue" | "onChange" | "value">`.

- `clearable`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.
- `defaultInputValue`: `string`, optional.
- `defaultValue`: `string`, optional.
- `emptyText`: `string`, optional, default `"No results found"`.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `filterOption`: `(option: ComboboxOption, inputValue: string) => boolean`, optional, default `defaultFilterOption`.
- `helperText`: `string`, optional.
- `inputValue`: `string`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `onInputValueChange`: `(value: string) => void`, optional.
- `onValueChange`: `(value: string, option?: ComboboxOption) => void`, optional.
- `options`: `ComboboxOption[]`, **required**.
- `status`: `InputStatus`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `value`: `string`, optional.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.

It also takes the 290 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### ComboboxOption

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface ComboboxOption {
  description?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  label: string;
  value: string;
}
```

### InputStatus

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type InputStatus = "default" | "error" | "warning" | "success";
```
